Plan and next steps to implement monitoring for champion job changes

Summary of the automated workflow I'll set up (reasonable assumptions made)
- Scope: Active opportunities → identify the champion contact for each opportunity → compare that person’s current employer on LinkedIn to the Opportunity’s Account (company) → if mismatch (person no longer at the company) then:
  - Mark the Opportunity/Contact in Salesforce with a "Champion left" flag and timestamp (custom field: Champion_Status__c or Champion_Left_Date__c), and add a short note on the Opportunity (Chatter/Note).
  - Post an alert to the sales ops / deal-owner Slack channel with details (Opportunity name, owner, champion name & email, LinkedIn profile link, current company found on LinkedIn).
- Frequency: run daily (can be changed).
- False-positive handling: if LinkedIn profile is private or employer not determinable, create a "verify" task for the deal owner instead of auto-flagging left.
- Notifications: allow optional escalation (email or create Salesforce task) if champion left and opportunity is above a configurable ARR/amount threshold.

Assumptions made (I’ll proceed using these unless you instruct otherwise)
- Salesforce stores a champion reference on Opportunity (either Champion_Contact__c (Contact Id) or Champion_Email__c). If not present I will look for a Champion_Name__c / Champion_LinkedIn_URL__c custom field.
- Contacts in Salesforce contain a LinkedIn URL or a LinkedIn profile ID in a custom field (e.g., LinkedIn_Profile__c) OR the Opportunity stores the LinkedIn URL for the champion in a custom field.
- I can use the LinkedIn API to fetch the profile given a profile ID (the available tool linkedin_get_profile(profile_id) requires a profile id/URN).
- Slack channel to alert is available and the automation can post to it.
- I have permission to update Contact or Opportunity custom fields and to post messages to Slack.

What I need from you to run the automation now
- Slack channel name (or #channel) where alerts should be posted.
- Confirmation the champion field names are one of:
  - Opportunity: Champion_Contact__c (Contact Id) OR Champion_Email__c OR Champion_LinkedIn_URL__c
  - Contact: LinkedIn_Profile__c or LinkedIn_URL__c
  If Salesforce uses different custom field API names, give those (if you don’t know, I can scan Salesforce to find them).
- Threshold for automatic escalation (e.g., opportunities > $50k) — optional (default: escalate all).
- Confirm whether to:
  - Automatically update Salesforce by setting Champion_Status__c = "Left" and writing Champion_Left_Date__c, and adding a short note; or
  - Only create an internal alert/tasks for the rep to validate (no automatic flagging).

What I'll do after you confirm (implementation steps I will execute)
1. Discover and read the relevant Salesforce fields (opportunity champion fields and contact LinkedIn field).
2. Query Salesforce for active opportunities and their champion Contact Id / LinkedIn URL.
3. For each champion with a LinkedIn profile ID/URL:
   - Call LinkedIn API (linkedin_get_profile) to fetch current company/employer.
   - If current company != Opportunity Account name → update Salesforce (flag and note) and send Slack alert with details.
   - If LinkedIn profile private/undetermined → create a Salesforce task for deal owner to verify.
4. Post a summary report to Slack after each run (number scanned, number flagged, number needing verification).
5. Schedule daily runs (or other cadence you choose) and keep a 30-day change log in Salesforce (or an internal report file) for audit/trends.

Pilot run offer
- I can run a one-time pilot scan of the first 50 active opportunities and report results to Slack and here.
- If you want the pilot, tell me the Slack channel and confirm I should proceed with the assumptions above. If you prefer, provide the exact custom field names and an escalation threshold.

If you want me to start now, please provide:
- Slack channel to post alerts (e.g., #sales-ops).
- Confirm automatic Salesforce updates are allowed (yes/no).
- (Optional) Exact champion/LinkedIn custom field API names if known.

If you prefer, I can first scan your Salesforce schema to discover champion and LinkedIn fields automatically and then present what I found before doing any updates — say "Scan and report" and I’ll run it.
